categories.main_business_segments: Chaozhou Three-Circle (Group) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electronic ceramic components industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of electronic components and advanced materials. Its main product lines include communication components, electronic components and materials, and new materials, serving sectors such as electronics, communications, consumer electronics, industrial electronic equipment, and new energy. The company also develops products for emerging fields like AI, data centers, automotive electronics, and bioceramics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages over 50 years of R&D experience in electronic ceramic components, mastering ceramic material preparation, forming, sintering technologies, and precision mold design. It has achieved large-scale production of key products such as MLCCs (multi-layer ceramic capacitors), ceramic inserts, and packaging components. The company emphasizes continuous technological innovation, including breakthroughs in high-capacity MLCCs, solid oxide fuel cells (SOFC), bioceramic materials, and precision ceramic structural parts for the semiconductor industry.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the electronics, communications, consumer electronics, automotive, industrial control, semiconductor, and new energy sectors. The company serves global markets with products used in mobile smart terminals, data centers, AI applications, optical communications, and biomedicine. Major customers are diversified, with the top five accounting for approximately 13.79% of sales, indicating a broad customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Guangdong Province, and has subsidiaries and operations in multiple regions including Shenzhen, Chaozhou, Nanchong, Deyang, Chengdu, Suzhou, Wuhan, and overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Germany, the Netherlands, Malaysia, the United States, South Korea, India, and Thailand. Its international presence supports production, sales, and R&D activities across Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chaozhou Three-Circle operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of electronic ceramic components and advanced materials. It supplies these components to downstream manufacturers in electronics, communications, automotive, and semiconductor industries. The company also engages in upstream R&D and material development to support its production capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and scale expansion to strengthen its core product competitiveness and market position. Strategic R&D focuses include enhancing MLCC technology, developing high-capacity and automotive-grade MLCCs, advancing solid oxide fuel cells, bioceramic medical components, and precision ceramic parts for semiconductors. It is building regional research institutes to foster innovation and talent development, and integrating AI technologies to improve information management and production automation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electronic components and materials, including MLCCs, ceramic inserts, and advanced materials. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. Sales are conducted via direct product sales to industrial customers domestically and internationally, with no significant reliance on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading domestic player with over 50 years of expertise and a growing international footprint. It emphasizes its technological advantages, broad product portfolio, and increasing market share in high-capacity MLCCs and advanced ceramic components to maintain competitiveness amid intensifying industry competition and import substitution trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 7.37 billion, a 28.78% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 2.19 billion, up 38.55%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and cash flow, with R&D investment increasing to nearly 7.91% of revenue. Total assets reached RMB 23.92 billion, reflecting a solid financial scale and positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through deep technological expertise in electronic ceramics, continuous innovation, and a comprehensive product matrix tailored to diverse applications including automotive, industrial, consumer electronics, and emerging sectors like AI and biomedicine. Its commitment to quality, reliability, and advanced manufacturing processes, combined with strong R&D capabilities and strategic investments in new materials and products, underpin its value proposition to customers seeking high-performance, customized electronic components.
